title: TReC: Evaluating Move-Induced State Changes in Instruction-Conditioned Go
abstract: arXiv:2611.17781v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a Go model predicts a move different from the expert's, coordinate distance measures how far the prediction lands from the reference. We introduce Transition Representation Consistency (TReC) to compare how the two moves change a board-state embedding. Both moves are executed from the same position under the game rules, and TReC is the cosine similarity between the two resulting representation changes. In experiments with a frozen KataGo network on 680 mid-to-late-game positions from five games, the gap between the highest and lowest candidate per position has a median of 0.01 to 0.08 for the direct successor-state cosine and 0.88 to 1.33 for TReC, depending on the evaluator layer. TReC follows coordinate distance only weakly: the rank correlation between a candidate's distance to the reference and its TReC, computed within each position, has a median of -0.19 over these positions.

translated_title: TReC：在指令条件围棋中评估落子引起的状态变化
translated_abstract: 当围棋模型预测的落子与专家的落子不同时，坐标距离衡量的是预测落点与参考落点之间的距离。我们引入了迁移表示一致性，来比较这两种落子如何改变棋盘状态的嵌入表示。两种落子都在相同的局面下根据围棋规则执行，TReC 定义为两种落子所产生的表示变化之间的余弦相似度。在使用冻结的 KataGo 网络对来自五局对局的 680 个中后期局面进行的实验中，每个局面中最高与最低候选落子之间的差距，对于直接后继状态余弦而言中位数为 0.01 到 0.08，而对于 TReC 则为 0.88 到 1.33，具体数值取决于评估器层。TReC 与坐标距离仅有微弱的关联：在每个局面内计算得到的候选落子与参考落点的距离与其 TReC 之间的秩相关，在这些局面上的中位数为 -0.19。
tldr: 本文提出迁移表示一致性指标，通过比较预测落子与专家落子按规则执行后引起的棋盘状态嵌入变化的余弦相似度来评估落子差异，实验表明 TReC 具有显著区分度且与坐标距离仅弱相关，能捕捉坐标距离无法反映的状态变化差异。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Transition Representation Consistency (TReC), which evaluates move differences by measuring the cosine similarity between board-state embedding changes induced by predicted and expert moves executed under game rules, showing that TReC provides strong discriminative power and correlates only weakly with coordinate distance.
